values.quote: enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds

values.meaning: magic damage returned to attackers who basic attack Rammus while active
values.quote: dealt {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance)}} {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The return damage triggers when an enemy lands a basic attack against Rammus while the buff is active, not from Rammus's own actions.
mechanics.quote: enemies that use a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} against '''Rammus''' are dealt

mechanics.claim: Deactivating Defensive Ball Curl ends the effect; it ends immediately if Powerball is cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' ends immediately if {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}} is cast.

mechanics.claim: It returns damage from on-hit effects and Runaan's Hurricane, but not from turrets or turret-like sources.
mechanics.quote: will return damage from attacks and/or abilities that apply [[on-hit effect]]s ({{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}) as well as from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} (will not return damage from [[turret]]s, {{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger}}, or {{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}})

mechanics.claim: The resistance scaling for the return damage recalculates over the duration as Rammus's armor/MR change, including the flat bonus from this ability itself.
mechanics.quote: The resistance scaling will factor from all sources, including ''Defensive Ball Curl's'' flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.
